skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Fated Hero
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Horrorlair's Enigma' Custom Line/Fated Hero. The actor plays the role of the hero chosen by fate, who descends into the Horrorlair not just to quell disaster and eliminate evil, but with the hope of finding treasures to improve her life.
skins.quote: Once a pauper, now the world's greatest hope. That's what the script says anyway, but Snowsant just wants to get at the treasure chest Whislash brought!
